occupations.name: Administrative Assistant
occupations.title: Administrative Assistant
occupations.description: Coordinate records, scheduling and clear operational communication.
occupations.portfolio_project: Create a documented scheduling and reporting workflow with a checked spreadsheet.

occupations.name: Customer Support Specialist
occupations.title: Customer Support Specialist
occupations.description: Resolve customer enquiries and document recurring service issues.
occupations.portfolio_project: Analyse a fictional support-ticket log and write an escalation guide.

occupations.name: Data Analyst
occupations.title: Data Analyst
occupations.description: Turn reliable data into decisions through queries, analysis and communication.
occupations.portfolio_project: Analyse a public dataset with SQL, validate the results and present a dashboard with limitations.

occupations.name: Business Analyst
occupations.title: Business Analyst
occupations.description: Translate stakeholder needs into clear, testable business requirements.
occupations.portfolio_project: Interview a volunteer stakeholder, map a process and write acceptance criteria for an improvement.

occupations.name: Business Intelligence Analyst
occupations.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
occupations.description: Build trusted reporting models and dashboards for business teams.
occupations.portfolio_project: Create a small star schema, a Power BI report and a reproducible data-quality checklist.

occupations.name: Operations Analyst
occupations.title: Operations Analyst
occupations.description: Investigate operational bottlenecks and measure practical improvements.
occupations.portfolio_project: Measure a fictional order workflow, locate bottlenecks and propose a tested process change.

occupations.name: AI Automation Specialist
occupations.title: AI Automation Specialist
occupations.description: Develop supervised workflow automations with checks and human review.
occupations.portfolio_project: Automate a document-routing workflow with an audit log, failure recovery and human approval.

occupations.name: Sustainability Data Analyst
occupations.title: Sustainability Data Analyst
occupations.description: Prepare traceable resource-use metrics and explain sustainability findings.
occupations.portfolio_project: Build a resource-use dashboard with metric definitions, reporting boundaries and source traceability.
